cases.caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
A bulldozer pulls a heavy load attached with a chain, moving it across the ground.
A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.

interpretation: All six declared400 fixed16 controls complete. Learned execution values improve PC versus routing_only but reduce SA/Joint; learned keys alone reduce PC versus anchor_only. Own reasoning/fullC superiority over unrelated/trainmean remains weak. These are inference interventions within jointly trained weights, not standalone retraining ablations.
